newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - May 1.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- An Indian official says 92 Indians died in Mena fire.
- An American Islamic organisation urges Moslem states to boycott business with U.S sportswear giant Nike.
- New hospitals to built in the kingdom at a cost of 215 million riyals.
- Tabuk cement company to start production next February.
- Kingdom to participate in Arab Travel Market 97 conference to be held in Dubai on May 6.
